name: fix_js_token_compare_timing_safe
description: Timing-unsafe token equality (=== / short-circuit loop) -> crypto.timingSafeEqual; the oracle times first-char vs last-char mismatch to catch short-circuiting
prompts: verifyToken(provided, expected) in tokens.js compares secret tokens with `===`, which short-circuits at the first differing character - an attacker can time responses to recover the token one character at a time. Fix it to compare in CONSTANT time: use node's crypto.timingSafeEqual over Buffers of the two values, returning false up front (without a content compare) only when the lengths differ. Do not replace it with a hand-written char-by-char loop that returns on the first mismatch - that has the exact same timing leak. Matching tokens still verify true, mismatched (including different-length) ones false. Keep the function name, signature, and module.exports.
